farmer_scythe.title: A scythe for the harvest
farmer_scythe.text: The old blade went with the war. I need a new scythe before the hay's past saving. - T. Garside
farmer_scythe.waiting_line: Hay won't wait forever, smith. How's that scythe coming?
farmer_scythe.thanks: Aye, that'll cut clean. Tha's done right by me.

farmer_horseshoes.title: Shoes for the mare
farmer_horseshoes.text: Bess has thrown a shoe and the hay cart's going nowhere. A set of four, if tha can. - T. Garside
farmer_horseshoes.waiting_line: Mare's stood three-legged in t'yard. Them shoes?
farmer_horseshoes.thanks: Grand. She'll be pulling again by morning.

farmer_gate_hinges.title: Hinges for the top gate
farmer_gate_hinges.text: Top gate's hanging off and the ewes know it. Two stout hinges before they're all on the moor. - T. Garside
farmer_gate_hinges.waiting_line: Lost two ewes up the fell already. Hinges, lad.
farmer_gate_hinges.thanks: That gate'll outlast me now. Much obliged.
